hooks.text: 以闪电般速度迎战同屏最多300名敌人的汹涌群潮
hooks.excerpt: Stand against waves of enemies unlike anything you’ve seen before; face up to 300 foes on screen at once, still able to move at Lightning speed.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 带回战利品到大师堡垒净化强化，再次投入战斗
hooks.excerpt: I return to the Master’s Citadel, cleansing what I’ve gathered, sharpening the edge of my soul. And once more, I plunge back into the fray, unbroken, stronger than ever.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 化身无面法师召来的武器，重塑被瘟疫摧毁的黑暗世界
hooks.excerpt: Born of the will of a faceless mage, I exist for one purpose alone: to become the weapon that reshapes a world ravaged by plague.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 视觉表现令人印象深刻。

excerpts.excerpt: The visuals are also rather impressive
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 蘑菇洞后的前进路径指引不清。

excerpts.excerpt: The way forward once you enter the mushroom cave was not clear
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 第三章探索秘密的回报很少。

excerpts.excerpt: with very little reward to exploration for secrets.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 玩家原有武器被全部禁用

excerpts.excerpt: 但为什么要把我所有武器都ban了？
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 正式版相比Demo新增内容过少。

excerpts.excerpt: 相比demo只多了一个序章，基本没有新内容
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 死亡后不能在天空节点复活，重跑路程浪费时间。

excerpts.excerpt: Just let me respawn at a sky node instead of making me go through 500 teleporters
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 暴风雪任务点相距过远，中间缺少有效事件。

excerpts.excerpt: These blizzards are so far apart from each other, with nothing happening on the journey in-between.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 该区域虽然更大，却因此显得更空旷

excerpts.excerpt: Even though this area as a whole was bigger, it was emptier because of it.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 整体玩法是作品最突出的优点

excerpts.excerpt: gameplay - that's where the gold hidden.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 第一章的难度提升节奏适合学习系统。

excerpts.excerpt: The difficulty goes up at a good rate for you to learn the ropes
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
